description: This file implements a Google Vertex AI Large Language Model (LLM) service class, extending a base GoogleLLMService. It manages authentication with Google Cloud, handles deprecated parameters, and creates a client for Vertex AI inference.

classes.name: GoogleVertexLLMService
classes.description: A class extending GoogleLLMService to integrate with Google Vertex AI, handling authentication and client creation for Vertex AI endpoints.

classes.name: GoogleVertexLLMService.InputParams
classes.description: A nested class defining input parameters specific to Vertex AI, including deprecated fields for location and project_id.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with credentials, model, location, project_id, and other parameters, handling deprecated fields and setting up credentials.

methods.name: create_client
methods.description: Creates and configures the Google Cloud Client for Vertex AI.

methods.name: _get_credentials
methods.description: Static method to retrieve Google Cloud credentials from JSON string, file, or default credentials.
